pugugly.notes: Bare-knuckle bruiser: cropped hair, a jaw of iron, the widest shoulders, sleeves rolled off bare forearms, both fists wrapped in linen (R). Nothing carried; the right fist is the hand anchor.

longbowmen.notes: The wall of Farkeep carried on a shoulder: a hood and its short mantle; the long bow stave (V) up the LEFT side of the back from the hip to past the crown; the leather quiver (T) on the RIGHT side, its fletchings (F) over the right shoulder and its strap across the chest to the left hip. Both hands free.

berserker.notes: Pistol and claymore: a bare head, the hair to the jaw, a fur collar (F) over the shoulders. The claymore rides the back, its hilt (W, grip N) over the RIGHT shoulder and the blade down the back; the pistol is holstered on the RIGHT hip. Both hands are bare and free.

rifle_rider.notes: A longbowman who earned a horse and traded the bow for a breech: the hood up, a riding coat to the knee split for the saddle, the bandolier (T, rounds Y) from the left shoulder to the right hip; the rifle slung on the back, its muzzle (W/w) over the LEFT shoulder and the stock (V) at the RIGHT hip. Both hands free.

recon_rider.notes: Quick, quiet, low damage: a short hooded cloak in the Farkeep grey (G; its hood is H = G) over the coat, no weapon. A satchel (T) on the LEFT hip; the spyglass (W/w) in the RIGHT hand.

shield.notes: The Republic's shield-bearer (the garrison and the marching column): a grey helm (H) with a nose guard (W), an iron jaw guard (w), the coat; THE SHIELD — tall, grey-steel (G), steel rim (W), cold iron boss (w) — on the LEFT arm; the spear (haft V, head W) upright in the RIGHT hand. Neither arm swings.
